scope: Original rotations and reflections; 24 variations over six marked motifs. Not an official paper.

questions.text: Turn the whole figure 90° clockwise (a quarter turn) about C. Which option shows the result?
questions.explanation: Option A. C stays fixed. Every corner and the solid dot make the same turn; the figure is not flipped. The dot moves from 24 units right and 15 units below C to 15 units left and 24 units below C. Check the outline as well as the dot.
